decision_conditions:
The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.


REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.

<span id="docs-internal-guid-b7d45c15-7fff-6f98-8c69-b9efc59b5503"><p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-left: 72pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 8pt;"><span id="docs-internal-guid-0b6087d6-7fff-ff35-f360-c6c276ad6ded"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.38; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 8pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Within three months of the date of this decision, the following structures shall be removed in their entirety and the fabric of the building made good to the satisfaction of&nbsp; the local planning authority:-</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.38; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 8pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;"><br></span><span style="background-color: transparent; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt; white-space-collapse: preserve; text-align: justify; text-indent: 36pt;">i) The unauthorised roof extension shall be removed in its entirety as required by the </span><span style="background-color: transparent; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt; white-space-collapse: preserve; text-align: justify; text-indent: 36pt;">enforcement notice of ref 2021/0015/ENF and the earlier brickwork, parapets and </span><span style="background-color: transparent; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt; white-space-collapse: preserve; text-align: justify; text-indent: 36pt;">butterfly roof shall be reinstated prior to occupation. The reinstatement shall be </span><span style="background-color: transparent; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt; white-space-collapse: preserve; text-align: justify; text-indent: 36pt;">accurate with regard to form, materials and method of construction, and shall be </span><span style="background-color: transparent; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt; white-space-collapse: preserve; text-align: justify; text-indent: 36pt;">maintained as such thereafter.&nbsp;</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.38; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 8pt;"><span style="background-color: transparent; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt; white-space-collapse: preserve; text-align: justify; text-indent: 36pt;"><br></span><span style="background-color: transparent; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt; white-space-collapse: preserve; text-align: justify; text-indent: 36pt;">Reason: To protect the character and appearance of the conservation area.</span></p></span>

<p>The following shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the LPA prior to the commencement of the relevant part of the works:&nbsp;</p><p><b>a</b>. Details of all proposed external windows and doors including large scale drawings showing each window and its masonry surround (elevations at 1:20 of each individual windows, sections and typical details at 1:5), product details, material, colour and finish</p><p><b>b</b>. Details and samples of all proposed external materials and finishes including:&nbsp;</p><p><b>i</b>. details of the brickwork proposed for the rebuilding of the V profile rear wall (top section) including product details, sample, details of brick bond, mortar mix and pointing style and coping style</p><p><b>ii</b>. Details of all roofing materials</p><p><b>iii.</b> Details of external rainwater goods, vents, flues and any external services or equipment (elevation drawings showing size and location, product details, material, colour and finish)</p><p><b>iv. </b>Details of proposed external balustrading (if applicable)</p><p>The works shall be carried out in accordance with the details so approved and shall be maintained as such thereafter.</p><p>Reason: To protect the character and appearance of the conservation area</p>

<p>All new external works and works of making good to the retained fabric shall be finished to match the original work with regard to the methods used and to material, dimensions, composition, form, colour, finish and profile unless otherwise specified in the details hereby approved.</p><p>Reason: To protect the character and appearance of the conservation area</p>
description: Ground, first and second floor rear extensions (retrospective); proposed amendments to openings at first and second floor; and reinstatement of the original roof form
